content.header: Committed to a Cleaner, Greener Community
content.description: The Solid Waste Management Team of Barangay Bagong Silangan, Quezon City leads the Rise to Rice Solid Waste Management Program, promoting responsible waste disposal and sustainable practices. Through education and community initiatives, we strive to transform waste into valuable resources, creating a cleaner and more sustainable future for all.

partners.title: Our Partners
partners.description: Our Solid Waste Management Program thrives through the support of our valued partners working together to create a sustainable community.

mission_vision.title: Our Mission
mission_vision.description: Establish a community with proper knowledge, the proper absorption of our waste and the proper care of our nature and environment.

mission_vision.title: Our Vision
mission_vision.description: A community that cares and values the environment and nature to become a peaceful and comfortable community.
